Dialogs.Dialog: Do you know that there are about 600 kinds of cherry blossoms？
Takane
There are that many？
Supposedly. There are even yellow-green ones.
Yellow-green!? Huh... I thought all cherry blossoms were pink.
...Hey, want to make it our goal to see every kind？
Haha. That will take such a long time.
Maybe it'll take a lifetime？
I guess.
Hehe, all the more reason. Pinky promise.
Takane
It's hot... Hey, want to rest in the shade for a bit？
Sure. Then grab us a bench. I'll be right back！
Eh？ Where are you going？
Sorry for the wait！
Welcome back... Eh？ Ice cream？
I ran back so it wouldn't melt. You looked a little pale, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
And you bought only one？ Hehe, you're so hasty.
...Oh. W-Well, you eat it first. I'll make another run...
Hey, let's just split this one？ And next time, we go buy them together.
...Leaving me alone again is forbidden.
Takane
Wow. It's like a yellow carpet, isn't it？
Yeah, and the days are becoming shorter...
...Since meeting you, I've come to like this time of year even more.
Why？
Because I can really feel how warm your hands are.
And I realize all over again that I don't want to be apart...
Hehe. Hey, let's pick up some ginkgo leaves？ Pressed, they'd make nice bookmarks.
Ah, so cold...
Takane
It feels colder with the leaves gone, doesn't it？ The wind blows right through.
Ah, I see... Usually, the leaves block the wind for us. That makes sense.
Right？ ...Hey, want to go somewhere warm？ I'm getting chilled.
...Geez. Why are you being so mean？
Because I'll warm you up, obviously. Here, give me your hand.
...That's not enough.
Eh？
If you give me a big squeeze, then okay？ ...Then I'll stay like this.
Takane
Hey. Let's compete to see who can run up these stairs and reach the shrine first.
Sounds good. Loser has to do whatever the winner says！
Hehe, now I'm fired up. Want a 50-step handicap？
Fifty steps against ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is rough... Even with none, we're probably even？
Geez, saying that. You've gotten a little more muscular lately.
I am？
Yeah, I can tell just by looking...
Is that... not okay？
Nope, very welcome. Knowing ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is watching makes me try even harder.
...I'll cut your handicap to 30 steps. But I'm definitely not losing.
Prayers done！ What did you wish for, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane
Secret. You're not supposed to tell anyone, you know？
The sign said so too... But I want to know.
...Making that face won't work.
Just a little！ A hint！
That you won't get any more... any more attractive than you are now.
Huh... Wait, that's the answer...
It's fine. You keep getting more wonderful... and it made me anxious, that's all. Sorry for being so selfish.
I'll work hard too, so I don't fall behind you.
Takane
I feel like I came to shrines more when I was little...
Ah, I get it. The grounds are big, so they're great for playing.
In the back of this shrine there's a patch of white clover. I made crowns there, and hunted four-leaf ones.
Such a girl～
Hehe, I am a girl. I played pretend a lot too. Trading crowns instead of rings.
...Playing wedding？
Yeah.
With a girl, okay？
I-I know that...
Hehe！ Let's go？ Let's make two and play pretend, okay？
Takane
Hah...
What's wrong, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？ Sighing like that.
The movie was wonderful. I long for a love like that.
Two people meet by chance, overcome obstacles big and small, and fall for each other more and more...
Hmm. But come to think of it, we're not all that different, are we？
Huh, am I wrong？
...No. You're not wrong.
I was just a little surprised. You felt that way too...
Hehe. I'm happy.
Takane
It was fun！
Yeah. That lead's action scenes were amazing！
Yes, they surprised me. Being able to move like that must be fun.
I bet ▲高嶺＊＊▲ could pull it off. You're good at body control.
Hehe. So could you, right？
Well, yeah.
Hey, how about we both aim to be action stars？
That could work, huh？ We'd end up famous as a married action-star duo！
Huh？
You... No, never mind.
Ahh, that was funny！ What did you think, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane
▲Takane＊＊▲？
Hehe... Ahaha！
Sorry... but... Hehehe！
(So ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is weak to that kind of humor... Then...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. Look, look at my face！
！ Stop...
How's this？
...Please... stop it... My stomach hurts... Hahaha！
(All right. When she's mad at me, I'll use this！)
Takane
What's wrong？
That movie was kind of hard to follow, huh？
If you didn't watch the TV series, you probably wouldn't get it.
Did you watch it？
Yeah. Okay, let me explain a bit.
Hmm... So that's why the heroine did that？
Right. And then the hero sensed the danger and rushed over.
I see... If you explain it this clearly, I should've asked from the start.
You're amazing. If there's anything else I don't get, will you teach me？
What an epic movie！
Takane
...Hey, what does SF stand for？ Space Fantasy？
Huh？ Ah, it's Science Fiction.
Right！ Of course... It was bugging me the whole movie...
...Meaning you don't remember much of it？
...Sorry. I was thinking about it to stay awake, and halfway through I forgot the movie.
Oh, but the part where the hero saved the heroine was lovely... I think？
(Maybe sci-fi just isn't her thing...)
▲高嶺＊＊▲... You look pale. You okay？
Takane
I'm... not good with these kinds of movies...
Seriously？
Haunted houses don't scare me at all...
Maybe it's the blood. ...There was a lot partway through.
I see... Sorry.
No, you were holding my hand the whole time, right？ That's why I could watch it until the end.
Yeah, you hung in there. But next time, don't push yourself, okay？
...Okay. Thanks.
Takane
How do you keep score in bowling？
Why？ The computer does it automatically.
I know. But I don't want to take it too easy.
Well, you'd be stuck when it counts. Like in survival bowling.
Geez, what's that？ Survival bowling？
In a primitive bowling alley, eat or be eaten...
Hurling foes left and right？
Yeah, like that.
Hehe！ Right, so I'd better learn, for times like that.
Then let's keep score ourselves while we play.
You do know how. Amazing. Teacher, please▼
Takane
What's keeping my score from going up, do you think？
Hmm. In your case, ▲高嶺＊＊▲, maybe your form？
I thought so. What should I fix？
Then let's practice a bit. Let me get a good look？
A good look？
Yeah.
I think I'd get even weirder...
Why？
...Geez. I wish I could be that clueless too.
Takane
That last ball was amazing...
Yeah, it had some decent speed.
Hey, how can I throw as powerfully as you？
Put your weight into it and fling it！
Hmm... not by feel. Something more logical...
Don't think too hard. Throw a lot and get a feel for it.
...I see. You're right. Okay, five more games today, at least.
Sure... Wait, that many!?
Takane
Phew...
Tired？
No. I just got kind of caught up in everyone's energy.
Ah, I get it. It takes energy, for the players and the listeners.
If you zone out, they point at you and fire you up.
Hehe, they were firing you up, weren't they？
That wasn't fair. I was really into the lyrics.
Really？
Yeah. It was about loving someone so much you can't stand it, right？
Amazing... I couldn't make out the lyrics at all. You could hear them？
(That's what you react to, ▲高嶺＊＊▲...)
Takane
That was fun, huh？ I knew a lot of the songs, too.
Yeah！ Jazz seems hard to get into, but it's actually not.
Some people go "Huh？" just from hearing "modern" or "swing," don't you think？
Hm？ Did I say something weird？
No. Papa collects records, so I know a little too, but...
You're the first person my age who can rattle off "swing" and "modern" like that.
Impressed？
...No. I fell for you all over again. Hehe...
Takane
The vocalist was amazing.
Yeah. All that jumping around, and his voice never got any weaker.
Same goes for you, right？ You do the same and never get out of breath.
On stamina alone, you might beat him, huh？
...Meaning I lose at everything else？
Hmm, who knows？
Hehe！ Okay, a hint. For me, there's only one number one. ...Hehe.
(All right, I'll take that as a compliment！)
Takane
Maybe I'll buy the CD...
Oh, you really like it, huh？
Yes. The ballad near the end was lovely.
Ah, that was good. Especially the piano, so bittersweet... And the last song was great too, right？
...Hehe.
Hmm？
We liked the same parts. It made me happy.
Hey, if I buy it, will you listen to it with me？
Of course.
Hehe, can't wait？
Takane
Hehe. It was fun！
Yeah, I should learn from that sense of humor.
Hehe, like what？
"Whale, whale, whale！" "A ladybug that keeps falling — a lady-bump！" "That octopus looks blue... octo-blues！" ...Just kidding！
(...Wh-Was that too lame？)
Amazing！ Hey, don't you have more puns like that？ I want to hear them！
(She loved it... ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s sense of humor is...)
Takane
Hey, the actress who played the lead...
Ah, she's famous, right？ Lately she was in the morning drama.
I see. That's why I thought she looked familiar.
And the guy opposite her was in it too. As the heroine's dad when she was little.
Oh！ Hey, do you watch it too？
I was curious what kind of shows ▲高嶺＊＊▲ watches.
I figured your dad would be fine with a morning drama, so I've been watching on the sly.
Why do you do such lovely things for me？
...Geez. Don't make me any more crazy about you.
Takane
Hmm？ What's wrong？
That ballad just now... was really lovely.
You're good at putting feeling into songs, aren't you？ Especially love songs.
Well, I'm thinking about ▲高嶺＊＊▲ when I sing them.
！ There you go again...
Because it's true.
...Enough. Come on, next song！
(I just finished singing...)
Takane
...Amazing.
What is？
You didn't take a breath in the chorus, right？ You must have great lung capacity.
Well, I train, so to some extent.
Is there anything else that comes in handy...
Else... ah, with my stamina, I could probably do all-night karaoke.
"All-night kara"？
Karaoke all night. How about it, girl, want to try it sometime？ I won't let you sleep▼
I'm sorry. That's impossible... I usually fall asleep at 9 o'clock.
(She took it seriously... And wait, isn't nine kind of early？)
Takane
...Hey, can I ask you a question？
Hm？ What is it？
What's this button？
Ah, press it and the machine harmonizes with you automatically.
And this voice changer makes my voice female, and ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s voice male...
Amazing...！
I should've asked sooner. Hey, let's do a duet next？
Oh, does the harmony thing work for duets？
Hey, does this clap button actually clap for you？ Are you listening？
(Haha, she's like a little kid.)
Takane
Hey, what would you do if this Ferris wheel suddenly stopped？
Right now？
Yes. And what if it took a really long time for help to come？
Well...
First thing, I'd hold ▲高嶺＊＊▲ tight, I guess.
I'd want to be right there, easing ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s fears as much as I can.
...Saying something that cool, is that okay？ You can't take it back, you know？
Totally okay. If you want, I can do it right now？
Then maybe I'll take you up on it？ ...Just kidding.
Takane
Why do all the Ferris wheels look the same？
Ah, true... They could have more personality.
Like making the outside look like a pumpkin carriage...
Ah, that would be wonderful.
Or fancier insides？ Like a princess's castle.
Yeah yeah▼
Add lacy curtains with lots of drapes, and you've got ▲高嶺＊＊▲'s dream Ferris wheel！
...You see right through me that much... That's a little frustrating...
(Thinking you're hiding it is the real mistake...)
Takane
Yeah. Keeping up with us at full speed, that's something.
I thought I might trip partway through.
If you weren't holding my hand, it would've been quite dangerous.
Well, even if you did fall, you wouldn't need to worry.
Why？
If it came to it, I'm strong enough to carry ▲高嶺＊＊▲ out princess-style！
Hehe, right？ Then I'll be counting on you▼
Takane
If ghosts like that really came after us, it'd be a little scary, huh？
Well, see, we've got a powerful weapon, right？
...？ What kind？
Our irresistible lovey-dovey aura at full blast, knocking the ghosts out！
Haha, just kidding！
Huh？ What's wrong？
When you say it, it doesn't sound like a joke. That's the problem...
Please don't go getting hit on by lady ghosts too, okay？
(That's not going to happen... And if it did, it'd be terrifying！)
Takane
Haa... That was amazing, huh？
Yeah. ...Hey, was I too hyper？
Huh？ It didn't bother me？ If anything, I enjoyed it more than usual.
I see. I felt people staring... Must be my imagination.
......Next time, maybe I'll be the hyper one？
Why？
Because otherwise you'll get worn down.
Worn down？ Me？
Yes. Worn down by everyone's stares. Geez... Do you even know how attractive you are？
(I'd like to say the exact same thing right back...)
Takane
Hehe！ Wasn't that last dip amazing？
Yeah, that whoosh and then the floaty feeling. It's indescribable.
Yes. And the squeeze after that！
Right！ And then the even bigger rush hits. This coaster's really something.
...Haha！
What？
I wonder if anyone listening would understand us.
We're like a couple who've been together for years. It's lovely. Hehe.
Oh, look, ▲高嶺＊＊▲. The princess is waving at us？ Whoa.
Takane
What's wrong？
She winked, didn't she？
Yeah, she did.
...She even threw a kiss at you.
...That's just fan service.
Oh, the prince is waving at me▼
What!?
It's fan service, right？ Hehe, next time I'll wave back too.
(Ugh, I'll watch what I say and do...)
Takane
Somehow, I feel like I am really in a fairyland.
How do I put it... It's really fantastic.
Yes. But I wonder why. It feels a little lonely too...
... ▲高嶺＊＊▲, give me your hand？
Huh？ ...Okay.
How do you feel now？
A little embarrassed, but I'm happy...
All right, then let's stay like this all day today.
...Okay. Don't let go, okay？
Takane
It kind of feels like I've come to Wonderland...
If ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is Alice, then I'm the rabbit？
Hehe！ Thanks for guiding me all day again, Mr. Rabbit▼
Which world will you take me to next？
Wherever ▲高嶺＊＊▲ wants.
Then guess？
My arms！ ...How's that？
Geez... It's wrong, but I'll count it as right. Take me there right away, okay？
Takane
Phew...
Here, a towel. You really are amazing, ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
What is？
Your swimming looks so good. Coming up through the waves, you looked like a mermaid.
There you go flattering me again.
It's true. Everyone was looking？
...Same goes for you.
Me？
...Geez. Today, I'm not leaving your side for a second, okay？
(I'm happy about that, but... why？)
Takane
Floating in a quiet pool, don't you get a strange feeling？
Feels strange？
Yes. Like I'm melting... I guess？
They say people are made of water. I feel like I get it.
It's so relaxing there's even therapy like that these days.
Huh, really... Sounds nice.
With so many people today, we can't, but...
Someday, I'd like to melt away somewhere. The two of us？
Takane
I really can't beat a guy...
Huh？
I swam just as much as you, but you're not tired at all, are you？
If we had the same stamina, I'd be the one in shock, you know？
Yeah, I agree, but...
Besides, I've got another source of stamina.
Another source？
Well, seeing ▲高嶺＊＊▲ in a swimsuit this close, who could get tired？
...Pervert！
That meteor shower projection was so pretty.
Takane
Yes. The sound was amazing too... but real meteors don't make a sound, do they？
Yeah, it's just for effect.
Right. Little kids might get the wrong idea.
That's where we come in, right？ Teaching kids.
Huh？
No. I was just thinking you'd make a wonderful daddy.
And next to you would be... Hehehe！
(She's enjoying herself... What's she imagining？)
Takane
People long ago had such rich imaginations, didn't they？ Connecting stars into gods.
They probably saw a lot more back then.
Now there must be lots of stars you can only see at a planetarium.
Yeah... And some have probably already burned out.
When I was little, I wondered how we can see light from hundreds of millions of years ago.
Even when someone explains "the speed of light is..."
Hehe. Hey, I bet we're not the only couple having a talk like this, are we？
There must be as many as there are stars！
And on that note, we take our bow. Hehe！
Being here makes me lose track of time.
Takane
Yes. I feel so at ease... That means I'm relaxed, right？
Maybe. Dim lights, quiet... But the biggest reason is...
What is it？
▲高嶺＊＊▲'s hand. I got so relaxed I nodded off partway through.
I almost fell asleep too. Your hand was so warm.
Then let's not next time.
No. Next time, we hold hands properly too. Understand？ Your answer？
Yes, understood.
Hehe, very good！
Takane
Living somewhere like this might be nice. The air feels so clean...
Just having lots of green makes you feel healthier, huh.
Yes. I wonder if it really does？
I think I saw somewhere that there are proper scientific results now.
Hmm... Being able to relax might be one of the effects.
Probably？ Zoning out, getting sleepy... like ▲高嶺＊＊▲ right now.
This is... partly your fault, you know.
Me？
Your warmth and your voice make me relax.
Well, I guess I'm sleepy because of ▲高嶺＊＊▲ too.
Geez, smooth talker... Then, let's rest just a little？
Takane
I wonder why carnivorous plants eat insects.
When the soil's poor, they get the nutrients they're missing from bugs.
That pitcher plant's big and impressive, but in rich soil they grow smaller.
Hmm...
Even the liquid inside that digests bugs just turns into water.
You know a lot. Do you study that kind of thing？
...Is what that sign over there says.
Huh？ When did you read it？
Every time we come. I've got it memorized now.
...That's frustrating. I'm going to memorize it too from now on.
(...Did I light a fire？)
Takane
Hmm？
Sorry. I dozed off... Was I heavy？
Not at all. If anything, I could use a little more.
Geez. Always teasing...
Ahh, so cold. My shoulder feels so light and lonely～.
...Hehe. Since I have no choice, I'll lean on it.
And I won't let go.
Takane
...You fell asleep partway through, didn't you？
Sorry. It just felt so nice, I couldn't help it.
I get it, but...
I wish they'd do a classical concert here where it's okay to sleep.
There are things like that？
Apparently. Sounds kind of nice, right？
Yes. I might want to go...
But they don't do those here, so don't fall asleep next time, okay？
...I don't want us to have nothing to talk about on the way home.
(Urgh！ I'll try...)
Takane
Lots of fans, huh？
They're breaking out right now. I see them on TV a lot lately.
Really？
Yeah. Fewer people in Japan don't know them than do, I bet.
...Hmm？
(Ah, crap. This is heading toward...)
I'm buying a magazine on the way home.
Eh？
Starting with gathering information. Mm.
(Ah, I knew it...)
Takane
Musicals are so strange...
Like when they suddenly burst into song. Especially right after Act II started.
Yes！ The moment they spun around to face us, with those huge smiles...
When they sing with smiles full of hope, you can't help smiling too.
Yes. Everyone around us was smiling too.
But your smile was the most wonderful. Eyes all wide.
You were watching...
Hehe！ Are you getting shy？ You're just so cute▼
(This is embarrassing！)
Takane
Hey, what was that move the winner used？
A cross armlock. Interested？
Yes, a little. Does it really hurt？
It must work pretty well. It's originally a judo move.
I see. Do you know how to do it？
Well... Don't tell me you want to try it？ Why？
I thought you could probably take it？ You train, after all.
Huh!? You'd be the one doing it!?
Of course. Just once！ Okay？
(Sh-She's serious!?)
Takane
Hey, what were those clacky things the fans had？
Ah, those are megaphones, technically. They split in two for cheering.
They looked fun...
Ah, I bet you'd get pumped, banging along with everyone.
Next time, want to join them？ While we're at it.
...Yes！
All right. Then first we need to get megaphones！
Yes, captain！ Hehe▼
▲高嶺＊＊▲, are you okay？ You look pale.
Takane
I'm a little... overwhelmed by the crowd...
That's not good. ...There's a bench over there. Can you make it that far？
Yes...
Then let's move. Take it slow, okay？
How is it？ Think you can walk？
Yes, I'm fine now. ...Sorry, after we came all this way...
Don't worry. With that many people, it can't be helped. Now, isn't there something you want to say to me？
...Thank you.
You're welcome！
Lit up, it really looks different.
Takane
Yes. It's pretty, and somehow...
▲Takane＊＊▲？
I'm... glad I met you.
If I'd stayed the way I was, I'd never have known a view like this.
Thank you for being with me. ...Hehe.
There's still more, you know？
Eh？
Things I want to show ▲高嶺＊＊▲... or rather, see together.
So let's keep this up, okay？
...Same here！
Takane
It's beautiful...
It's a worn-out phrase, but it really is like stars on the ground.
But I don't think there's a better way to put it？
Better than that... ▲高嶺＊＊▲.
Huh？
You're my shining star.
How's that？
...That wasn't about the night view, so you fail！
...But it made me happy, so you pass. I hope I can be your star forever...
That was something. Those seagulls had no manners. ... ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane
Why？ Only to you.
I-I don't know...
It's not fair.
Even if you say that, I mean...
Not just girls, even birds.
I-It was a coincidence！
Girls looking at you too？
That's maybe different, but...
...Geez, I don't care anymore.
(Ugh, what am I supposed to say！)
Not tired, ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
Takane
Yeah... Maybe I got too excited. I'm a little sleepy.
You were swimming all out, after all.
Because you suddenly said "Race！"
And you didn't go easy on me at all.
If I did, you would get mad.
Right. Hehe. You really know me well.
Because I'm your boyfriend. And I wanted to show you my strong points.
I saw plenty of them. That's why I'm sleepy now, you know？
I'll take responsibility and keep you company for a nap. I'll keep watch. Rest easy.
Then I'll take you up on that？ Thanks, Mr. Bodyguard▼
I'm getting hungry. We also ran out of drinking water. I'll buy some.
Takane
Okay. Hurry back, okay？ I'll time you▼ Ready, go！
Hey, doing this all of a sudden is too sneaky！ Ah！ I'll be right back！
Welcome back. Wow, you set a new record！
I-I'm back... Here, yakisoba and a hot dog, and water.
Thanks▼ Ah, no chopsticks.
Seriously!? Ugh, guess I'll make another run...
Ah, I'll go there. You rest here, okay？
Thanks... Ready, go！
Huh, you're timing me？ Really？ Geez, no fair！
(She actually runs. ▲高嶺＊＊▲ is so conscientious...)
Takane
The sunset reflecting on the sea... It's beautiful.
Yeah. I never notice it normally, but the setting sun seems to move fast.
Hehe, I know... Hey, do you see that rock over there？
Yeah. What about it？
There's a rumor that if lovers watch sunset from that rock, they will be blessed with happiness.
Huh... Next time we get the chance, let's go.
Geez. I was going to say that.
First move wins. Oh, the sun's already gotten that far.
Yeah, today was really fun. Thank you.
Takane
An empty beach is nice and relaxing too, huh？
Yeah. Kind of a nice change of pace.
Right, I used to come here often with Papa and Mama when I was a child.
Hmm？ How about now？
Still sometimes. But lately I've learned to be a little considerate, you know？
In what way？
I give them time alone. When I was little, I had to squeeze in between them, but...
Now I like watching them from behind, holding hands and smiling.
Meeting you... maybe I've grown up a little？ Hehe.
Takane
The wind is so loud...
The waves sound sharper than in other seasons, too.
Yes. At times like this, I feel like I'd only think lonely thoughts...
Like, what if the world ended right now？
Something like that. If it did, what would you do？
Me... I'd want to spend it with someone precious.
What a coincidence. Me too.
Could that be... the person whose hand you're holding right now？
Yep, good guess.
Hehe. Then as a reward, give me a squeeze？ Enough to blow away the cold and the loneliness.
It really is cold...
Takane
But you can see the stars well, can't you？
Yeah. Looks like it'll be clear tomorrow too... Ugh, cold！
That cold？ ...Hehe, I've got a good idea. Hey, hold still？
Hm？ Okay... ▲高嶺＊＊▲？
This way your back's warm, right？
It's warm, but...
Huh？ What？
Um... I'm getting hot in a different way, kind of...
...You're thinking about something weird, aren't you？ Pervert！
(What do you want me to say～！)
Takane
Do the sunfish here like people？ They come right up.
Apparently some kinds of fish are friendly.
Is that so？
Yeah, I saw it somewhere the other day.
Hey, do you remember any others？ Friendly fish.
Um, boxfish too, I think...
We have to go. The boxfish were over there, right？
Ah, hey, ▲高嶺＊＊▲！
Better hurry, or I'm leaving！
(She sounds like the sweet potato truck. Is ▲高嶺＊＊▲ actually kind of impatient？)
I wonder what this sunfish has been thinking while it was swimming.
Takane
Hehe, maybe it's thinking about nothing but food.
Haha, could be. But what if it's thinking something really romantic？
Hmm... like what？
One day, a little fish from outside tells it, "Ever heard of the ocean？ It's nothing like this cramped tank."
Ever since, it's been distracted. What's the ocean like？ Could it meet the love of its life there...
